title: How cold known places get (Kelvin)

source.name: Cosmic microwave background temperature; Boomerang Nebula temperature

notes: Room temperature ~293K (20C). Deep space's cosmic microwave background sits at 2.7K, leftover heat from the Big Bang. The Boomerang Nebula, 5,000 light-years away, measures about 1K -- colder than deep space itself because its gas is expanding and cooling faster than the CMB can reheat it.
